Use case: stylized-concept. Create MAIN front reference of one stone castle GATEHOUSE for Wonder Chess. Attached hero image is STYLE ONLY: painterly semi-realistic fantasy clean3D render, soft even studio light, believable worn materials. Never include any character.
A single rectangular gatehouse block,8.4 metres wide,10 metres tall. Depth3.6 metres so it stands proud of the2.6m wall. NOT two towers. Warm-grey large limestone blocks, softly worn edges, restrained mortar, sparse moss low down, no tiny cracks/noisy detailing. At center a tall ROUND semicircular arch opening with a completely CLOSED dark iron portcullis: heavy vertical bars crossed by horizontal bars, all reaching down to baseline. The opening is a passage through the block. Above the arch centered a short deep royal-blue #24468F cloth banner bearing one aged-brass #B8923A sun. Five simple broad stone merlons along front top, matching rear parapet. No roof or windows, no side towers or wings or torches or doors.
Crucial modular geometry: left and right outer ends are identical FLAT vertical CUT PLANES, from the bottom to the top; no corner pilasters, projecting end caps, buttresses, side eaves or plinth extending beyond either cut plane. Adjacent straight wall modules must butt against them. Both end faces same height and thickness. A subtle stone base plinth flush at these ends. Keep broad simple clean geometry.
Exact FRONT straight-on orthographic elevation, no yaw, no pitch; no side faces seen. Whole object centered on square1254x1254PNG, top at8% and baseline92%, width84% of object height (8.4:10). Generous empty margin. Plain light grey #E6E6E6 background, no floor, no ground/contact/cast shadow, no landscape, no text, no labels, no people. Lower contrast/desaturation than hero. One view only.
files.review: Front has five merlons, single tall round arch with fully lowered portcullis and blue/brass sun banner. Flat broad sides; side-face agreement remains to be checked.
